answer_1.quote: We introduce FairPrism, a dataset of 5,000 examples of AI-generated English text with detailed human annotations covering a diverse set of harms relating to gender and sexuality.
answer_1.outputs: AI-generated text in reply and continuation scenarios, including chatbot responses, emails, stories, and other generated content

answer_2.quote: We used the HateXplain classifier to rate the perceived toxicity of the AI-generated outputs for each of our data sources...

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to collect FairPrism's annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked about the presence of stereotyping and demeaning harms, target demographic groups, generalizations, false attribution of harmful views, ignoring demographic characteristics, advocating violence, impersonation, and other issues.
